  My main worry is that the lane guard depends on a plugin that Pi might not load, might fail open on, or might bypass. To be convinced, I'd want a test where Pi attempts an out-of-lane write and gets
  blocked, every denied call logged, and a plugin crash that blocks the call instead of allowing it. I said this is based on the description only, not the plugin code.
